the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Prove injectivity of the base change map to the limit by putting pairs of cycles mapping to the same element into the closed equal locus and descending into it along the inverse system using the constructible containment lemma, then prove surjectivity by pulling the given relative cycle into the image of the cycle-classes construction over a completely decomposed proper cover, descend the covering morphism and the flat closed subschemes to some finite level with the descending machinery of the Limits chapter including the descent of completely decomposed morphisms, compare the two pullbacks of the descended cycle class to the double base change and make them equal after increasing the index by the injectivity part, descend uniquely along the completely decomposed cover with the descent lemma for families and land in the group of relative cycles by the h-descent lemma, and conclude the descended cycle maps back to the given one by uniqueness (source lines 1396-1460)
